parsed.modern: Nor have we Bacon's opinion only, but his affiance too, in favor of originals. His mighty mind traveled round the intellectual world; and, with a more than eagle's eye, saw, and has pointed out, blank spaces, or dark spots in it, on which the human mind never shone: some of these have been enlightened since; some are benighted still.
